title: SequenceManifest
description: Schema for the curated UGtastic rewatch episode sequence manifest.

curator.description: Host and curator name with credentials.

total_episodes.description: Total number of interview episodes in the manifest (codas are counted separately).

manifesto_anchor.description: Historical anchor to the Software Craftsmanship Manifesto.

primary_archive_route.description: Default web path to the local interview archive.

era_id.description: Identifier matching the community timeline era.

era_name.description: Human-readable era name and date span.

interviewee.description: Full name of the interviewee or focus practitioner.

conference.description: Conference or user group where the interview was recorded.

location.description: City and state of the event.

sound_above_inquiry.description: Core question probing earlier influences and inspirations.

chicago_context.description: Specific historical connections to Chicago software community.

ai_era_parallel.description: Connection to modern multi-agent systems and AI engineering.

companion_video.description: Related keynote or historical video for split-screen rewatching.

status.description: Production lifecycle status of the episode.

total_codas.description: Number of codas: non-interview closing broadcasts kept apart from the interview episodes.

codas.description: Non-interview closing broadcasts (host demonstration, open roundtable). Not rewatches.
